mapper.insert: insert into coop_review (topic_id, from_id, to_id, rating, comment, create_time, del_flag) values (#{topicId}, #{fromId}, #{toId}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{createTime}, #{delFlag})
mapper.select: select count(1) from coop_review where topic_id = #{topicId} and from_id = #{fromId} and to_id = #{toId} and del_flag = 0
select id, topic_id, from_id, to_id, rating, comment, create_time, del_flag from coop_review where to_id = #{toId} and del_flag = 0 order by create_time desc
select COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rating),1),0) as avgRating, COUNT(1) as reviewCount from coop_review where to_id = #{toId} and del_flag = 0
